run_apply_fp8_marlin_linear: run the apply_fp8_marlin_linear function to perform FP8 weight-only Marlin GEMM with optional bias
prepare_fp8_layer_for_marlin: prepare a single FP8 layer for Marlin weight-only quantization by repacking weights and scales
prepare_moe_fp8_layer_for_marlin: prepare an Mixture-of-Experts FP8 layer for Marlin weight-only quantization across all experts
apply_fp8_fused_exponent_bias_into_scale: apply fp8_fused_exponent_bias_into_scales to adjust FP8 scales by fusing exponent bias for fp16 or bf16 targets
run_marlin_quant_fp8_torch: run marlin_quant_fp8_torch to quantize FP8 weights with group-wise scaling and repack into Marlin format
